description:
Search your durable memory for facts that are not in the memory section of your prompt: older journal entries, notes that have aged out of the recent slice, and shared user facts recorded by any of this user's assistants.
Read-only. Results list each fact with its date, memory type and, for shared facts, which assistant learned it.
Prefer this tool over grepping memory folders.

query.description: What to look for. Facts sharing the most distinctive words with the query rank first; when nothing overlaps (short identifiers like a ticket id or an acronym) a literal case-insensitive substring match is used instead.

within.description: Search only this memory type, such as profile.
